function finite(v, min = 0) { if(typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(v) || v < min) throw new Error('Invalid numeric input'); return v; }
export function analyze(d) { if(!Array.isArray(d.prices)||d.prices.length<2) throw new Error('At least two prices required'); const prices=d.prices.map(p=>finite(p,Number.MIN_VALUE)); let peak=prices[0],maxDrawdownPct=0; for(const p of prices){peak=Math.max(peak,p);maxDrawdownPct=Math.max(maxDrawdownPct,(peak-p)/peak*100);} const grossReturnPct=(prices.at(-1)/prices[0]-1)*100; return {grossReturnPct,maxDrawdownPct,netReturnPct:grossReturnPct-finite(d.feeBps??0)*2/100}; }
